meta.title: A staggered event refuses a non-surrogate bid on this endpoint

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Not allowed to bid on this product”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: A staggered event refuses a non-surrogate bid on this endpoint

expected.message: Not allowed to bid on this product
